title: Actuator Systems — Joint Classification and Motor Fault Detection
description: Classify actuator loads by joint, motion, and intensity. Detect motor faults: overcurrent, overtemp, stall, encoder loss, phase imbalance. 8 joints × 3 intensity levels. 7 fault types with severity routing.

tools.name: classify-actuator-load
tools.description: Classify actuator load by joint (shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle/spine/neck), motion type, and intensity level. Returns torque class, peak power, motor type, control mode, and power tier recommendation.

parameters.name: joint
parameters.description: Joint: shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, ankle, spine, neck

tools.name: detect-motor-fault
tools.description: Detect motor/actuator faults from sensor readings. 7 fault types: winding overtemp (critical/warning), overcurrent (critical/warning), encoder loss, stall, phase imbalance. Returns fault type, severity, and recommended action.
